gorseller.istem: On a rough warm plaster wall at night: in the lower center foreground a single detached pale beige gecko tail with a clean smooth tapered end, lying curled in an S shape and glowing softly in warm lamp light; far above in the upper corner only the hind half of a realistic Mediterranean house gecko about 10 cm long (pale, slightly translucent beige skin with small bumps, two big dark eyes with vertical slit pupils, four short legs: two front and two hind, each foot with five broad toes) scurrying out of the frame, its own tail now a short blunt stump. Only one tail in the picture.
gorseller.not: Kopan kuyruk: temiz, pürüzsüz, kan yok; S şeklinde kıvrık. Geko yalnız arkadan, duvara yassı, bacaklar yanlara açık, köşede küçük. | 2. tur (28 Kas): görsel denetçi düzeltmesi.
